sceneDescription: Ico kibanza giserukira urudodo rwa Helia rw’uyu mucukumbuzi. Ivyuma vy’icatsi kibisi bikeye ubu bihuye n’umucukumbuzi kandi bifise umurongo uja hagati. Ivyuma vy’ibara ry’agahama vyavumbuwe biciye ku nzira y’umucukumbuzi ariko ntibihuye. Ivyuma vy’inzahabu ni amahuzu yuguruye atangazwa n’umudayimoni wa Kubo wo mu karere atandukanye; si amahuzu y'umucukumbuzi kandi nta murongo uja kuri iki kigo. Inyenyeri zipfuye z’amabuye y’agaciro zizigama amateka atagira aho zihuriye, kandi umurongo w’ibimenyamenya vyazo ukurwaho gusa iyo zicitse. Urugendo ruva ku makarita yo hagati rwagereranywa igihe co guhagarara; urunganwe rutagereranywa rufata inzira y’inyuma, kandi imigwi y’imfuruka y’ugutwara ibintu vyerekanwa. Inyenyeri zishaza ziri inyuma ntizigereranya urunganwe. Inzira y’inyuma y’umubiri igaragaza umurima wa Kubo wazanywe kandi si ihuriro. Igipande c’ibarabara kigaragara gusa iyo ID y’ibarabara iriho mu rwego rw’urunganwe rwerekanwa; topologie y'urunganwe n'urunganwe ntabwo yigera ivugwa. Koresha umugenzuzi w'urunganwe ku makuru amwe mu buryo bw'inyandiko.
fallbackBody: Iki gikoresho nticashobora kurema ikibanza ca WebGL gitekanye. Ivyiyumviro vya Helia biguma biboneka biciye ku mugenzuzi w’urunganwe.

observationScopeBody: Iyi browser’s ishobora gushikira ababanyi hamwe n’ivyo Kubo abona mu karere; n’ugukurikirana ku 2.048 no guhindurwa ku 1.024, nta na rimwe urubuga rwose rwa IPFS.
heroTitle: Ubucukumbuzi buhoraho bwo kwihweza · ikirere kizima c'urunganwe rushobora gushikwako
heroBody: Uyu mucukumbuzi arabona abo mu runganwe rwabo bashobora gushikirwa, agapima inyishu zabo, kandi agatanga ibimenyamenya gusa bivuye muri iki kiganiro. Nta kintu na kimwe hano kigereranywa.
settingsSummaryAuto: Ubwiza bw’ivyuma burakingira igipimo c’amafoto kandi bukagaruka iyo ahantu hakonje.
settingsSummaryManual: Ivyo vyatowe birakingirwa; uburyo bw'amaboko ntibuzokwisubirako.
controlsForward: WASD canke imfunguruzo z’umwampi zigenda zigazunguruka kamera.
controlsOrbit: Fata urukurura rw'ibubamfu, canke uhindure ukande iburyo mu buryo bwa kamera, kugira ngo uzunguruke.
controlsHover: Hover umugenzi kugira ngo ubone amakuru arambuye; n’ukoreshe canke ukande kugira ngo ushireko ikarata yayo y’ikimenyamenya.
controlsSelect: [ / ] guhitamwo abo mu runganwe, Injira amapin, Esc yirukana.
controlsTouch: Ku bigaragaza bikora ku mubiri, gendagenda kugira ngo uzunguruke, ukande kugira ngo ugende, hanyuma ukande kugira ngo ugende.
controlsBindingHint: Niwibande ku vyo uboshe, hanyuma ukande urufunguzo urwo ari rwo rwose kugira ngo urusubirize. Ivyo biboshe bibikwa kuri iki gikoresho gusa.
